title: Edmund and the Witness
author: Isandro Yarrow
blurb: Jude Underhill, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
